name: 1.1.Verify Page redirections for Top 500 Pages
description:
Verify that every URL in the site's top-500-by-traffic list (cypress/e2e/Pages/PageRedirectionPages/Top500PageUrls.js) responds successfully — no HTTP 404 (not found) or 5xx (server error), and no internal URL is missing its trailing slash.

Expected: Every one of the ~500 highest-traffic pages should return a successful response (not 404, not 500+) and use a correctly-formed URL (trailing slash present). Any failing URL should be listed by the test so it can be triaged individually.
